claim: Share your 3060 Ti overclock results! : r/nvidia - reddit.com
summary: EVGA 3060 Ti FTW3 - timespy of 11900 stock, boosting to ~2025mHz. My best result so far is holding core voltage to 1000mV, setting core target to 1950mHz, and upping mem frequency by 1000, this gets about 12600 in timespy.
